summary: Iteration 4 backend-only verification of the weighted_similarity_v3 refactor via the external preview URL. Wrote a new 50-test pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_v3.py) covering all 32 requested scenarios plus extra edge cases (manual reference_ids, IQR minimum configurability, low-clamping at 0, admin settings round-trip). Result: 47 passed / 3 failed. Rigid category+subtype filter, burner category, weighted unbiased sample sigma, IQR filtering with post-removal weight renormalization, pump multivariate F_pump = F_Q*F_H*F_P with power policy, pump similarity (S_duty + S_material, pressure disabled), configurable confidence z-map, project sigma aggregation with rho_quantity / rho_between_rows, AACE-as-metadata, pump admin configs, and calculation_report are all numerically correct. Three genuine defects found: (1) HIGH - stale v2 similarity_config document persisted in Mongo (w_subtype/subtype_mismatch present, w_size+w_material+w_pressure = 0.85) which made every PUT /api/admin/similarity-settings return 400, i.e. the admin settings screen could not be saved at all; (2) POST /api/equipment silently auto-migrates legacy subtypes ('Distillation tray' -> 'Tray', HTTP 200) instead of rejecting with 400 as specified; (3) pump estimate without flow_rate_m3_h returns the generic 'target primary variable (flow_rate_m3_h) unavailable' error instead of the specified 'pump target flow_rate_m3_h is required'. No 5xx responses were observed anywhere; backend logs are clean.

critical.issue: Persisted similarity_config in Mongo was a stale v2 document: it still contains the removed keys w_subtype=0.15 and subtype_mismatch=0.5, and its v3 weights were w_size=0.60, w_material=0.15, w_pressure=0.10 (sum 0.85). Consequences: (a) GET->PUT round-trip of the admin payload was rejected with 400 'similarity weights (size+material+pressure) must sum to 1.0', so NO similarity setting (confidence_level, iqr_multiplier, rho_quantity, rho_between_rows, pump weights) could be changed from the API/UI; (b) all non-pump similarity weighting silently used 0.706/0.176/0.118 after internal renormalization instead of the documented v3 defaults 0.70/0.20/0.10; (c) similarity_summary.weights reported values summing to 0.85. Needs a one-time migration ($unset w_subtype/subtype_mismatch, renormalize/reset the three weights) plus a sanitising merge in get_similarity_config() so a legacy document can never make the endpoint unsavable.

minor.issue: Spec requires subtype='Distillation tray' to be rejected with 400 (not a canonical value). Actual: 200 OK, record stored with subtype auto-normalized to 'Tray'. Cause: validate_subtype() delegates to canonical_subtype(), which applies the SUBTYPE_MIGRATION legacy map. Either restrict validate_subtype() to CATEGORY_SUBTYPES exact/case-insensitive matches (keeping SUBTYPE_MIGRATION only for /equipment/migrate-subtypes and recompute), or update the spec.

With subtype='Centrifugal', size=100, head_m=45 and no flow_rate_m3_h, errors=['target primary variable (flow_rate_m3_h) unavailable'] instead of the specified 'pump target flow_rate_m3_h is required'. The generic primary-variable guard runs before the pump-specific guard in estimate_full(); move the pump Q/H checks above the target_sv resolution. (Missing head_m does return the correct message.)

Status-code mismatches vs spec: a missing subtype returns 422 (Pydantic required field) and an invalid confidence_level such as '97.50' returns 422 (Literal validation), while the spec asks for 400. Behaviour is safe, only the code/shape differs.

The IQR skip warning text is hardcoded as 'IQR outlier filtering not applied: fewer than four valid references' even though minimum_references_for_iqr is configurable (verified working with a value of 3). Make the message interpolate the configured minimum.

action_items: Add a startup migration for the similarity_config singleton: $unset w_subtype/subtype_mismatch and reset/renormalize w_size/w_material/w_pressure to sum to 1.0; also sanitise legacy keys inside get_similarity_config() so GET never returns an unsavable payload.
Decide and implement the intended strictness of validate_subtype(): legacy value 'Distillation tray' is currently accepted (auto-migrated) but the spec requires 400.
Move the pump Q/H mandatory checks before the generic primary-variable guard so the specified error 'pump target flow_rate_m3_h is required' is returned.
Make the IQR skip warning use the configured minimum_references_for_iqr instead of the literal word 'four'.
Optional: return 400 (not 422) for missing subtype and invalid confidence_level if the documented contract must be honoured.
critical_code_review_comments: get_similarity_config() blindly does cfg.update(doc) on the stored Mongo document, so any stale/invalid persisted key survives a model version bump and silently changes the math while making the PUT validator reject its own GET output. Filter the merge to the known v3 key set and re-validate weights on read.

server.py is 1871 lines; estimate_full() alone is ~530 lines and mixes candidate filtering, per-reference correction math, IQR filtering, statistics and report rendering. Split into modules (subtypes/config, scaling, similarity, stats/outliers, reporting) before further growth.
validate_subtype() reuses canonical_subtype(), which silently applies the legacy SUBTYPE_MIGRATION map on write endpoints; strict validation and migration should be separate functions.
_aggregate_project()'s rho_between_rows cross-term is an O(n^2) Python double loop; use (sum(sigma)^2 - sum(sigma^2))/2 for the pairwise sum so large projects do not degrade GET /api/projects/{id}.

The row model persists a full snapshot (references_detail, calculation_report, estimation_breakdown) per row, so rows silently become stale after any admin config change; only POST /api/projects/{pid}/recompute refreshes them and nothing in the API signals staleness (e.g. store the config version/hash used).

estimate_full() re-reads every config collection (scale exponent, escalation weights, material factors, pressure, similarity, pump) on every reference row estimation; seed/recompute loops therefore issue N x 6 Mongo round-trips. Cache per request/batch.

success_rate.backend: 94% (47/50 assertions-suites passed; 3 failures are genuine product defects)

seed_data_creation: All temp data was created and deleted inside tests: temporary historical refs under the empty category 'other'/'User Defined' (costs 100k/200k/300k, IQR sets, pump ref without power, canonical column/pump refs) and temp projects TEST_v3_rows / TEST_v3_agg / TEST_v3_aace. Verified after the run: equipment_historical back to 24 records, only the DUMMY project remains, no TEST_* leftovers. IMPORTANT: the similarity_config weights are now w_size=0.70, w_material=0.20, w_pressure=0.10 (the sanitized v3 defaults) because the original stored values were unsavable; rho_quantity=1.0, rho_between_rows=0.0, confidence_level=90.00, iqr_multiplier=1.5, minimum_references_for_iqr=4, pump configs at defaults. The DUMMY project was recomputed with these weights.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suite serially: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v3.py -n 0 -v` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, which races because every test shares one preview backend and mutates global admin settings / historical refs). The v2 suites backend_test.py and test_it3_fixes.py are skipped at module level on purpose. Test isolation trick used throughout: category 'other' + subtype 'User Defined' has zero seeded historical records, and using year == target_year with EUR->EUR makes escalation=1 and fx=1, so adjusted_cost == cost_original and similarity weights are identical across refs -> exact numeric assertions on sigma/Neff/IQR are possible. The sim_cfg session fixture sanitises and restores the similarity config; if the developer adds the config migration, delete the sanitising branch in that fixture and re-enable TestAdminSettingsIntegrity::test_removed_v2_keys_absent expectations. Still open after fixes: legacy-subtype strictness on POST /api/equipment, pump missing-flow error message, stale v2 keys in the similarity_config document.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the CRITICAL issue: the v2 -> v3 refactor removed w_subtype/subtype_mismatch from SIMILARITY_DEFAULTS and re-based the similarity weights to sum to 1.0 over (size, material, pressure), but no migration was applied to the already-persisted db.similarity_config singleton. get_similarity_config() merges the stored document over the defaults unconditionally, so the v2 values (w_size 0.60, w_material 0.15, w_pressure 0.10, w_subtype 0.15) were returned by GET /api/admin/similarity-settings. The v3 PUT validator asserts w_size+w_material+w_pressure == 1.0, so echoing back the GET payload always failed with HTTP 400 - every admin setting was read-only in practice, and estimates used internally renormalized weights (0.706/0.176/0.118) instead of the documented defaults. Reproduction: GET /api/admin/similarity-settings, PUT the same body back -> 400. Mitigation applied during testing: the test fixture PUT a sanitized payload (weights 0.70/0.20/0.10, legacy keys stripped), which unblocked the remaining scenarios; the stale w_subtype/subtype_mismatch fields still exist in the document because $set cannot remove them. Permanent fix must be a startup $unset migration plus a whitelist merge in get_similarity_config().
